findings.title: probe-claude-tick.sh feeds the exact expected `orchid version` string into the prompt and then greps the reply for that same string, so the version half of its "real output, not a hallucinated marker" evidence can be satisfied by echoing the prompt back (only the independent `integration_branch` check still discriminates); a generic hint plus the checkout-derived grep would keep them independent
`tests/test_manifest.sh:320` still says "ORCHID_VERSION is fixed at 1.0.0 for the rest of this suite" while the neighbouring comments at 267/304 were updated to 1.0.0-beta.1

the identical widened regex now exists in four hand-synced copies (`scripts/release.sh:61`, `install.sh:69`, `docs/install.md:106,122`), but only release.sh's copy gained shape tests — install.sh's stable-channel gate has no negative coverage, so a future loosening there is undetected
